query:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (line_code)
                routes.id,
                agency_id,
                code AS line_code,
                name,
                type,
                description,
                routes.route_code AS code,
                route_paths.path as "path!: _" 
            FROM routes
                LEFT JOIN route_paths
                    ON route_paths.route_code = routes.route_code
                    AND route_paths.city = $3
                
            WHERE 
                ST_DWithin(
                    route_paths.path::geography,
                    ST_SetSRID(
                        ST_MakePoint($1, $2),
                        4326
                    )::geography,
                    $4
                )
                AND routes.city = $3
